name: o46408

savingsAccounts.title: Savings Accounts
savingsAccounts.description: Array of savings accounts. An empty array will never be returned. In the instance that no savings accounts exist for the supplied NINO, a MATCHING_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND error will be returned.

id.title: ID
id.description: The unique identifier of the savings account. For example SAVKB2UVwUTBQGJ

accountName.title: Account name
accountName.description: Friendly account name. Each account name added must be unique for that National Insurance number. The account name must be between 1 and 32 characters in length. Allowed characters, including spaces are: mixed case alphanumeric characters and the characters; &'()*,-./@£

instructions: Please remove the first 2 items from the "savingsAccounts" list.

modification.precise_instruction: Remove the first 2 items from the "savingsAccounts" list.
